description: The native_model_shapes documents whose shape only appears on the BUILD-TIME path: each one ingests a committed parquet table through its own `data_sources`, so a binding evaluates its rules in the build pipeline rather than on the right-hand-side path. Every assertion is the document's own, computed by hand. Each binding runs every document under `interpreter` and `native`; both must pass every assertion and native must equal the interpreter bit for bit. `url_overrides` maps each source to its table, relative to this directory, for a runner that does not resolve the document's relative `url_template` itself.

binding_notes.julia: Not gated here: parquet needs Parquet2, which is not in EarthSciAST.jl's test target. Julia evaluates these shapes through the same evaluator as the non-ingesting fixtures of ../manifest.json, which it is gated on.
binding_notes.python: Out of the scope of the native-models round; see ../README.md.

fixtures.note: A value-equality join of an ingested key column against a const-cadence computed key (moves fixtures, 479 rules; moves F57/F58 controls once ingesting).
A causal self-reference in a document that ingests (moves F24b; nr-logging-county and nr-airtoxics-lawn-garden-county fold rules).
A gather through an ingested index column (the isrm member-index and per-record layer gathers).
An overlap-gated containment binning over ingested cell envelopes (every isrm E_* rule).
An inline assertion naming the data-fed parameter itself, and a state integrating it (moves finding F43).
